name: how-to-use-browser
description: Browser automation skill for web page interaction. Two strategies: (1) Snapshot + refs for simple static pages; (2) JavaScript-first for login forms, SPA, and dynamic pages (PREFERRED). Covers opening URLs, snapshots, clicking, filling forms, evaluating JS, screenshots, tab management, and navigation. Built on go-rod/CDP with headless Chrome. If snapshot returns 0 element refs, DO NOT retry -- switch to JavaScript strategy immediately.
